correctness.rationale: Encode rim as F2[z]/(z^n+1), B=z+z^-1=z^-1(z+1)^2, and hub coupling via all-ones J and parity S. The map is (Bx+hJ,Sx). For even n, BJ=S(Bx)=0 and S(J)=0 give F^3(x,h)=(B^3x,0). Characteristic-2 factorization z^n+1=(z+1)^k q isolates a nilpotent length-k primary factor; B is invertible on q. Its powers have rank n-min(2t,k), and the coupled first two powers have the explicitly stated exceptional ranks. For odd n, S(J)=1 and F swaps hub/parity bits while acting invertibly on q. The kernel of B^t-I on q has dimension deg gcd(q,(z²+1)^t+z^t). This gives fixed counts, primitive cycles by Möbius inversion, the stable image dimension, basin factors and exact preperiod distribution. Independent row-reduction checks over GF2 for wheel matrices and gcd fixed counts corroborate bounded cases.

value.rationale: All-circumference and all-time classification of a natural hub-plus-cycle XOR automaton, showing reversible odd wheels, two-adic transient jumps and exact periodic/basin counts.

final_claim: For every n>=3, open-neighbour GF(2) wheel adjacency dynamics has the exact all-time fixed-point polynomial-gcd formula; all odd-rim states are recurrent, whereas for even rim n the recurrent subspace size is 2^(n-k), k=2^v2(n), with maximum preperiod 3 for k=2,4 and k/2 for k>=8, and an exact rank/preperiod distribution.
limitations: Binary synchronous open-neighbour rule only; cycle counts remain finite polynomial gcd expressions.
No claim that state enumeration alone establishes infinite n or t.
